name: answer
description: Buy a response from the owner's authorized AI proxy, grounded in the owner's approved publications. Payment settles at submission and returns a ticket immediately; poll result until it completes. Questions are retained and visible to the owner. Unsupported questions are refused after payment. Refunds are not automatic: a refused or failed answer is marked owed back to your paying address, and the owner refunds it.

name: discover
description: Return this node's full catalog of owner-approved publications: teasers grouped by topic, with ids, freshness, and price. Free. Choose zero, one, multiple, or all ids; call get once per chosen id.

name: get
description: Fetch one owner-approved publication by its id from the discover catalog. Each call buys exactly one publication. Damaged ids are rejected before payment, and an id that is no longer for sale returns an error and is never charged.

name: result
description: Fetch the outcome of a paid answer ticket. Free and idempotent; keep polling while status is running. Terminal statuses: complete, refused (no coverage), failed (agent error or timeout). Refused and failed answers are marked owed back; the owner refunds them.
